subject: C41
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/request-rows.ts:21-32 and request-editor.tsx:345-349: parseRows trims values every time the controlled table renders. Typing a space at the end of the current input removes it before the next character, so ordinary multiword Params and Headers values are silently changed. Independently reproduced with the real RequestEditor and user-event: typing 'hello world' displayed 'helloworld'; Send captured 'q=helloworld' and 'Accept: helloworld'. Also reproduced an unrelated row edit changing an existing 'q=  padded  ' to 'q=padded', contrary to desktop-core's verbatim query-value contract in workbench/document.rs:102-124. The retained row tests use single-word values and miss this input corruption. Acceptance: preserve in-progress spaces in both tables and preserve query-value whitespace when editing other rows; add component regressions using character-by-character multiword entry and an existing padded query value, asserting exact Save and Send fields.
